text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and Stock E at gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a profit; decide based on each stock’s prospects and my plan.","When I dislike admitting a mistake, I may hold a losing position too long. I should reassess it objectively rather than let my purchase price decide.","Doing nothing was reasonable during these small account swings, but I should still review my holdings periodically instead of letting loss aversion or inattention make the decision for me."]}
